subject: mathematics
concept: Final mastery check and reflection on the complete K-12 mathematics journey, confirming readiness for post-secondary or applied mathematical work
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative capstone review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews a timeline of their own math journey from early number sense through calculus and modeling
exercise.abstract: Student completes a comprehensive capstone assessment drawing on model selection, construction, solving, refinement, and communication skills, and reflects in writing on their growth across the full K-12 sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed capstone question types, plus a passing independent modeling project and reflection
misconception_flags: any capstone-unit misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
next_node_on_fail: MATH.G12.CAPSTONE_MODELING.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
